title: Joining the 1 Billion Club: Google's Gemini App Experiences Rapid Growth

content_html:
On the artificial intelligence track, Google is accelerating its pace further. The company's CEO Sundar Pichai recently announced on a social platform that the monthly active users of its Gemini app have officially exceeded 1 billion, becoming one of the fastest-growing products in the company's history. This also marks the 14th core product of Google to enter the "1 Billion Users Club."

With this milestone achieved, Gemini has matched OpenAI's ChatGPT in terms of user scale, which also reached a monthly active user base of 1 billion in June this year. Currently, Google has deeply integrated Gemini into all corners of its ecosystem, including search, Workspace, Android, and standalone apps. Among them, the AI mode in the search product also has more than 1 billion monthly active users globally; however, the 1 billion figure announced this time focuses solely on the Gemini standalone app.

In terms of technical iterations, Google continues to launch new models and features, such as Gemini 3.5 Flash, designed to optimize code writing and autonomous AI agent tasks. At the same time, the official also revealed some interesting data about user interaction with AI: 63% of users are accustomed to communicating directly with the assistant via voice function, and the number of images generated by the app daily has exceeded 150 million.

Outside the domestic market, Gemini's active users on the iOS platform have already exceeded 10 million. This achievement comes after Google's second-quarter 2026 financial report was released — at that time, the company had just celebrated reaching nearly 950 million monthly active users and a threefold increase in daily active users over the past year. With the upcoming "Made by Google" product launch event, it is expected that more innovative features powered by Gemini will be introduced to various Pixel devices.

content_html_zh:
在人工智能赛道上，谷歌正在进一步加快步伐。 该公司首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)近日在社交平台上宣布，其Gemini应用程序的月活跃用户已正式突破10亿，成为该公司历史上增长最快的产品之一。 这也标志着谷歌第14个核心产品进入“10亿用户俱乐部”。

随着这一里程碑的实现，Gemini 在用户规模方面已追平了 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT，后者在今年 6 月的月活跃用户数也达到了 10 亿。 目前，谷歌已将 Gemini 深度整合到其生态系统的各个角落，包括搜索、Workspace、Android 和独立应用程序。 其中，搜索产品中的AI模式在全球也拥有超过10亿月活跃用户；不过，此次公布的10亿数字仅集中在Gemini独立应用程序上。

在技​​术迭代方面，谷歌不断推出新的模型和功能，例如Gemini 3.5 Flash，旨在优化代码编写和自主AI代理任务。 同时，官方还透露了一些关于用户与AI交互的有趣数据：63%的用户习惯通过语音功能直接与助手交流，该应用每天生成的图像数量已超过1.5亿张。

在国内市场之外，Gemini的iOS平台活跃用户已经突破1000万。 这一成就是在谷歌发布 2026 年第二季度财务报告之后做出的——当时，该公司刚刚庆祝月活跃用户数达到近 9.5 亿，日活跃用户数较过去一年增长了三倍。 随着即将举行的“Made by Google”产品发布会，预计更多由 Gemini 提供支持的创新功能将被引入到各种 Pixel 设备中。
